newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to cut August wholesale product prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to cut August wholesale product prices.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would lower its wholesale prices for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene for August shipments by 1.3 yen per litre.
It will be the fifth consecutive month in which the refiner has cut monthly wholesale prices for its oil products.
The cut is a result of a decline in June-loading crude oil prices as well as the yen's appreciation against the dollar, a Nippon Oil spokesman said.

Following the reduction, the wholesale price of gasoline will be 88 yen per litre and gas oil 66.3 yen per litre, both including tax, while the price of kerosene will be set at 34.2 yen a litre. Kerosene is not taxed at the wholesale stage.
Major Japanese oil companies review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international crude prices as well as fluctuations in the currency market.
